deploybot: [Deploy] Build pipeline kicked off for staging
- release: v2.4.1

:rocket:

maria: ack, watching. any ETA on build matrix?

deploybot: Step updates: checkout -> install -> lint -> unit-tests -> integration-tests -> docker-publish

ci-bot: lint: passed (0 warnings)

jon: nice. ping me if unit tests fail — I pushed a flaky fix earlier.

ci-bot: unit-tests: passed (42/42)

ci-bot: integration-tests: failed (1/18)

sam: which test failed? can you paste the failing log?

ci-bot: ```
FAIL: tests/e2e/session_timeout_test.py::test_timeout_reconnect
AssertionError: expected reconnect within 5s, got 12s
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/e2e/session_timeout_test.py", line 48, in test_timeout_reconnect
    assert reconnect_time <= 5
AssertionError
```

maria: hmm that test has been flaky on arm nodes. which executor did this run on?

ci-bot: executor: staging-runner-12 (node: node14-cache-miss)

jon: "node14-cache-miss" — that name rings a bell. we had a broken dependency cache on that pool yesterday. Sam can you check the executor health?

sam: looking. `ssh staging-runner-12` shows docker layers missing for our test image. cache miss + slow pull = timeout spike.

sam: I can rerun the integration stage on a different runner. want me to requeue?

maria: yes please requeue on runner with warmed cache (staging-runner-03). also add a retry flag for flaky e2e: `--retries=2` for now.

sam: requeued integration-tests on staging-runner-03 with retries=2. new build id: 6790.

deploybot: [Update] integration-tests (rerun) started -> https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/6790

ci-bot: integration-tests (rerun): passed (18/18) :tada:

ci-bot: docker-publish: skipped (no image change)

deploybot: Build pipeline succeeded for staging — release v2.4.1, commit abc123def

maria: great. I'll proceed with the canary rollout this afternoon during the change window. leaving a note in the release doc about the flaky test and cache pool.

jon: once canary is green, let's pin the runner label in the pipeline config to avoid node14-cache-miss until infra is patched.

sam: filing infra ticket: INFRA-512 to investigate cache warmers on that pool. cc @eng-infra

maria: thanks everyone. marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
